summary: Tested 'Flag Missing For Follow-up' feature end-to-end. Backend endpoints (flag-missing, follow-ups list, resolve) all working. Frontend Stock-takes modal has working History/Follow-ups tabs with dynamic count, flag button toggles correctly (idempotent — stayed 'Flagged for follow-up' disabled on already-flagged stock-take from prior curl test), resolve control removes item and decrements count (17 -> 16). Regression: new stock-take with manual entry (1 of 20 found, 19 missing) shows 'Flag for follow-up' on done screen; clicking flags all missing and switches to 'Flagged for follow-up' disabled.
critical_code_review_comments: resolveFollowUp swallows errors silently — a failed PUT will still optimistically remove the item from the UI (line 66-72 of StockTakeHistoryModal.js). Consider only removing after success or surfacing an error toast.

flagMissing on the done step (StockTakeModal.js) does not refresh the report’s missing/follow-up state; only local 'flagged' boolean is toggled. Fine for one-shot but doesn't re-hydrate if the user reopens history.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing iso-demo stock-take. Created 1 new stock-take (1/20 found) during regression test which will remain in history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified end-to-end. Existing iso-demo stock-take now flagged with follow-ups (16 open after resolving one during test). A new small stock-take was created and flagged during the regression run.
